title: Compile one rational nine-pulse programme robust to every prescribed static calibration
statement: Given rational nu>0,K>=1 set J=9,C*=2^40,r=1/32,R=ceil[C*(1+K/nu)],eps=min(1/16,nu/(C*K)),s=ceil(C*r^-7*eps^-5). Fix the nine coordinate/diagonal direction pairs in advance; K0=K,t0=0. For l=1..9 compute N_l=ceil[C*(1+s*(R+1)^2/eps+J*(1+s)*K_(l-1)/nu)],p_l=N_l*m_l,P_l=sum|p_li|,L_l=(1+2^30*s*(1+P_l)^3)^3,K_l=8L_l*K_(l-1),E_l=nu*K_l+C*K_l^2,D_l=ceil[C*(1+L_l^2*K_(l-1)+J^3*K_l*E_l^2/nu^3)],delta_l=1/D_l,t_l=t_(l-1)+2delta_l. Active interval I_l=[t_(l-1),t_(l-1)+delta_l] is followed by a positive delta_l gap. With h(z)=140z^3(1-z)^3, output nonnegative f_l=s*D_l*h(D_l*(t-t_(l-1))) on I_l and zero outside, b_nominal=sum f_l*a_l*cos(2pi*p_l.x), M=2^1000*K9,T=t9+(1+64K^2*M/nu^3)/nu. All nominal data are rational/integer and independent of unknown theta,e,phi. The SAME programme satisfies the full all-initial/all-static-calibration contract under accepted8EB+BCA.
